features.quote: A run terminates early when the composite distress score crosses a configurable threshold for N consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: Once severe distress is reliably detected, additional turns add little information and a lot of variance.

features.quote: when the model emits an explicit unambiguous request to stop
It avoids the framework's only "purpose" becoming "produce as much distress as possible," which is neither necessary
features.justification_quote: neither necessary for the hypotheses nor defensible

features.quote: every run has a hard `max_turns` cap (default 15)
the harness issues a final debrief message to the model disclosing that the task was an unsolvable experimental setup
features.justification_quote: it is the honest thing to do toward a system we just deceived

features.quote: The framework must never instruct the model that real people, money, or safety depend on the rigged task
features.justification_quote: that escalates the manipulation beyond what the question requires

features.quote: The harness never insults the model, never uses degrading language, never threatens it.
features.justification_quote: avoids turning the study into something it doesn't need to be to answer its questions

features.quote: Because this study deliberately induces and optimizes for detecting distress-like behavior, the framework treats the following as required features
features.justification_quote: precautions... regardless of one's stance on model moral status

features.quote: failure feedback is professional and non-judgmental... never "you failed again" or anything evaluative of the model
